content.page_title: 2024 ESC Guidelines for the management of atrial fibrillation - Task Force Members (declarations of interest)
content.summary: Declarations of interest reported to the ESC by task force members for guideline development (covering previous calendar year(s)). Lists experts, year(s) and types of relationships with industry, research funding and affiliations.

details: Payment from healthcare industry to department/institution for personal services (speaker fees, honoraria, consultancy, advisory board fees, investigator, committee member).
Membership/affiliation in political or advocacy groups: ESC, EHRA, AHA.
Non-industry research funding: Unrestricted research grant from ZonMW and the Dutch Heart Foundation; DECISION project 848090001.
Unrestricted research grants from the Netherlands Cardiovascular Research Initiative (projects RACE V (CVON 2014–9), RED-CVD (CVON2017-11)).
Unrestricted research grant from Top Sector Life Sciences & Health to the Dutch Heart Foundation (PPP Allowance; CVON-AI (2018B017)).
Unrestricted research grant from the European Union’s Horizon 2020 research and innovation programme (EHRA-PATHS, 945260).
Ongoing research funding from public and/or not-for-profit organisations (projects RACE V, RED-CVD, DECISION, EmbRACE).

content.notes: Page lists financial relationships, research grants, industry payments and affiliations relevant to ESC guideline contributors. Conditions mentioned are primarily clinical trial or indication descriptors (e.g., Atrial Fibrillation, Dyslipidaemia, Iron Deficiency, Ischaemic heart disease / arterial hypertension) and not gene names.
